clues: This town sits on a high flat plain in the mid part of its state in Brazil. Rail lines cross here on a trade route that runs to the south.
The town record high is not high at all, yet its record low drops below the freeze point. Some days in the cold months stay below that point too.
The town was set up for good in the year 1810. Its first homes were made by mule train men and the kin who came with them.
No town in its state makes more wealth from farms and herds than this one. Its fields and cows lead the whole state in the farm trade.
No other town in its state spreads across as much land as this one. Its wide bounds make it a hub for all the towns near by.
